definitions.explanation: The act of entrusting a task or responsibility to someone.

definitions.gloss: non-regular employee; contract worker; part-time staff
definitions.explanation: An employee hired on a contract basis, often a retired person rehired at reduced pay and hours. Common in Japanese government offices and companies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嘱託|しょくたく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We commissioned the investigation to an expert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{法務|ほうむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嘱託|しょくたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To entrust legal affairs to an outside lawyer.

examples.english: After retirement, I am working as a contract employee.

examples.english: The city hall is recruiting contract staff.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {嘱|しょく} (entrust) + {託|たく} (entrust, commission). Sense 1 is used as a suru verb ({嘱託|しょくたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Sense 2 is commonly used as a noun modifier ({嘱託|しょくたく}{社員|しゃいん}, {嘱託|しょくたく}⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嘱託|しょくたく}{社員|しゃいん} (contract employee)
- {嘱託|しょくたく}⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧ (contract staff)
- {嘱託|しょくたく}{医|い} (consulting physician)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}→契約社員：12260_keiyakushain⟧: contract employee — a broader term for any contract-based worker
- ⟦{派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん}→派遣社員：18875_hakenshain⟧: temporary worker — sent by a staffing agency
- ⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧: regular employee — a permanent, full-time employee
